statement: On R11 fixed equal-total schedules, stepup-minus-constant train descent-speed gain was positive in tree-index time in both environments (synthetic mean 0.004256879126726967, adjusted 95% family4 CI [0.00319455579167358,0.005319202461780355]; breast_cancer mean 0.0016625764263010839, CI [0.0013709968758980947,0.001954155976704073]). The prespecified cumulative-learning-rate clock gave negative corresponding contrasts (synthetic mean -0.02412183355432826, CI [-0.03371496643591244,-0.01452870067274408]; breast_cancer mean -0.05136558044625129, CI [-0.05352673234988818,-0.04920442854261439]). Stepdown-minus-constant was supported negative only on synthetic; the breast-cancer primary adjusted interval crossed zero. This is a whole-schedule, clock-dependent optimization control, not a natural CatBoost mechanism or double-descent result.
limitations: This is a whole-schedule intervention, including different pre-boundary training histories, not an isolated LR jump with identical initial trees/gradients.

Tree-clock and cumulative-LR-clock slopes have different units. Their numerical effect sizes must not be subtracted or compared as a common estimand; the claim concerns signs of within-clock schedule-minus-constant contrasts.
Cumulative prescribed LR is a diagnostic clock, not a proved exact optimization time for CatBoost or a fixed quadratic operator.
Each of the primary and LR-clock families has4 nominal Bonferroni-adjusted intervals. They do not jointly provide95%coverage across all8 quantities; n12 Student-t inference is approximate.
Synthetic repeats are new data/split/model units. Breast-cancer repeats are split/model units conditional on one fixed corpus, not independent new corpora or clinical validation.

First successful numerical attempt is preserved with operational revise for missing inference-resource assurance; actual excess CPU was unmeasured. Both attempts remain charged, share the same12 units and exactly identical raw prediction values, and do not form independent replications.

Observed scheduled acceleration is a positive optimization control, not naturally discovered late acceleration, a new general method/theorem, a CatBoost annealing mechanism or double descent. Novelty priority and journal readiness are not certified.
All raw arrays and72 model hashes were checked, while detailed model inference was spotchecked on6 models rather than independently rerunning training.
